subject: Re: Novafin Mutual Action Plan (MAP) - weekly checkpoint
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@novafin.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@novafin.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Novafin Mutual Action Plan (MAP) - draft & next steps

Hi Amy / Tom —

Great to connect earlier today. Appreciate the time and context on Novafin's pricing engine and expected Q3 rollout. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align milestones, owners, and target close. Highlights below — please confirm owners and any timing adjustments: 

- Milestone 1: Technical POC (env ready, test dataset) — Owner: Novafin (Tom Alvarez) — Target: 2027-07-09
- Milestone 2: Security & Compliance Review (SOC2 scope / data flow) — Owner: Novafin Security (Amy Chen) + Redwood Security — Target: 2027-07-16
- Milestone 3: Contracting & Commercials (T&Cs, pricing) — Owner: Novafin Procurement (procurement@novafin.com) / Redwood Sales — Target: 2027-07-30
- Milestone 4: Production Cutover (pilot -> prod) — Owner: Novafin Eng / Redwood Ops — Target: 2027-08-13

Dependencies called out in the MAP: networking/VPC peering window, SOC2 evidence transfer (read-only logs), and procurement signature turnaround. I attached Novafin_MAP_v0.3.xlsx with a column for "Open Questions / Blockers" and an initial resource RACI.

Next steps: can you please: 1) confirm owners above, 2) flag any timeline changes, and 3) add any missing stakeholders (legal/procurement contact if different)?

I'll follow up with a short 15-min checkpoint next week if that helps keep momentum.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: Novafin_MAP_v0.3.xlsx (Excel, 42KB)]
From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@novafin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@novafin.com>, procurement@novafin.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novafin Mutual Action Plan (MAP) - draft & next steps

Thanks Marissa — great summary and thanks for pulling the MAP together. A few quick notes after syncing with our security and procurement leads:

- Confirming owners: Tom will own the POC milestone. I will own security/compliance review but will loop in Legal (cc'd procurement for contracting timeline).
- Procurement / legal timing: procurement estimates initial review + redlines will take ~2 weeks once legal has the SOW. So please plan contracting milestone target for 2027-08-06 instead of 07-30.
- Networking dependency: we need a short window from our infra team to schedule VPC peering; I'll ask Tom to propose two slots next week.

I've cc'd procurement@novafin.com (Ben Lowe) — Ben, would you be the right contact for contracting? If not, please point us to the correct person.

Thanks —
Amy Chen
Director, Security & Compliance
Novafin

Hi all — quick technical follow-up from our SE side after reviewing the MAP and target windows. Two small clarifications that affect the POC milestone scheduling:

1) VPC peering: we'll need a 2-hour maintenance window to validate peering + egress rules from your infra team. Best to schedule this during a low-traffic window; Tom, can you propose 2 candidate slots next week?
2) Test dataset: to validate latency and cost projections we'll need a ~5k-record sample in CSV/Parquet; Marissa, I've added an explicit "deliverable" row in the MAP for this.

I've attached an updated MAP (Novafin_MAP_v0.4.xlsx) with the procurement date Amy suggested (2027-08-06) and the new deliverable rows. Also added a technical owner for the peering step and a checklist for our infra handoff.

Best —
